Let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13996467/assets/ca5e8035505f20619b6707d6d1f2d0b7b2f125a004a0dbd9d448840b0e4ffd99.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x)$ is $(-\infty ,\infty ).$

Now, substituting $x=\sqrt{3}$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,\sqrt{3}}tan\,(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x)-\frac{\pi }{6}) & =tan\,(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\sqrt{3})-\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}-\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$
